blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We present Piccolo, a family of multimodal decision models (0.8B to 27B) that coevolves model capabilities and training data via Agentic Data Engineering and recursive self-improvement (RSI). The models predict probabilities over candidate answers for general-purpose text and visual judgments, agent harnesses, data workflows, and interactive games. Piccolo-27B tops the Decision Index Vision Full leaderboard with a score of 75.59, while Piccolo-9B and Piccolo-4B achieve 68.35 and 67.46, respectively. All three rank first on the Private benchmark in their respective model-size categories. Research agents analyze model behavior, construct training data, conduct experiments, and use the results to refine subsequent proposals. Semantic slices and a shared research memory connect these actions across the model family's development. With training recipes comprising hundreds of thousands of examples, data selection and feedback-driven refinement are central to the self-improvement process. Our large-scale RSI exploration yields three counter-intuitive insights for decision-model development: (1) Backbone-recipe co-adaptation outweighs raw model recency: earlier backbones can surpass newer generations on visual tasks under identical recipes; (2) Targeted data curation enables 4B-9B models to rival 27B baselines on specialized workflows; and (3) Continuous loss reduction can decouple from and even degrade discrete decision accuracy. Together with the released weights and tools from the Data-Juicer and AgentScope ecosystems, Piccolo provides an actionable blueprint for building frontier decision models and scaling data-driven RSI.

While generative models excel at open-ended synthesis, real-world autonomous systems bottleneck on decisions, such as selecting actions, enforcing guardrails, and routing workflows under strict latency and reliability constraints.
A decision model maps a supplied state, question, and candidate set to probabilities over answers or actions Kirkby et al. [2026] , Dhankhar et al. [2026] , Zhuang et al. [2026] .
We present Piccolo, which implements this Jev-like interface for text and images through direct candidate-logit readout from a language-model head. Its System-1-style predictions support Choice over alternatives, Score on ordered levels, and Noul for yes/no judgments. Callers can select actions, threshold confidence, or escalate decisions using the returned distribution; Appendix B gives the formulation.

blocks.en: Agentic Data Engineering drives Piccolo’s RSI. Training dynamics and fine-grained data buckets characterize where the model learns reliably, where progress stalls, and which capabilities compete. Linking these responses to domain, supervision, and task structure turns an aggregate score into a map of capability boundaries. Agents use this map to propose data changes, build experiments, and carry the resulting knowledge into the next research decision Ding et al. [2026] . Researchers interactively guide objectives and introduce methods while agents automatically revise mixtures, synthesis targets, and training choices. Shared assets preserve discoveries and lessons throughout evolving progress.

(1) Data granularity dictates capability trade-offs : Fine-grained filtering sharpens agentic workflow decisions, whereas broader adaptive mixtures favor general text reasoning (Section 4.2 ).

These observations connect the RSI design to the family-level results and the experiments behind them. In summary, our main contributions are threefold: • A multimodal decision model family: competitive size–quality trade-offs, leading Vision Full and size-specific Private results, and applications from enterprise workflows to interactive control. • A data-driven RSI methodology: fine-grained feedback, explicit proposals, and reusable experiments turn model development into a continuing agent-led research loop. • Empirical insights for decision model development: systematic findings connect supervision, validation coverage, synthesis, backbone selection, and post-training to concrete experimental outcomes.

blocks.en: We use weight-space optimization to search for improved decision accuracy by directly modifying the trained model parameters. Candidate weights are constructed by interpolating checkpoints, rescaling parameter projections, or applying directions extracted from previous training updates Akiba et al. [2025] . This allows us to explore combinations and adjustments of learned parameters without running a new gradient-based training stage for each candidate. Appendix C summarizes more details of RL objective and these refinement methods.

blocks.en: 2.3 Data Sources and Preparation
blocks.zh: 第2.3条 数据来源和准备

blocks.en: To support generalization across domains, task structures, and input modalities, we collect a broad range of text and visual decision data. The collection spans everyday decisions, computing and technology, mathematics and science, humanities, and arts. Existing sources and synthesized tasks cover reasoning, retrieval, preference judgments, visual interpretation, and action selection. Appendix C.1 provides the source inventory.
blocks.zh: 为了支持跨领域、任务结构和输入模式的概括,我们收集了广泛的文本和视觉决策数据。 藏品涵盖日常决策、计算和技术、数学和科学、人文和艺术。 现有来源和综合任务包括推理、检索、偏好判断、视觉解释和行动选择。 附录C.1提供了来源清单。

blocks.en: Training on these heterogeneous sources requires preserving the evidence and conditions that justify each target while making their supervision consistent with the shared decision interface. Conversion places each question in the ( s , u , C , q ) (s,u,C,q) format, retaining action preconditions, relevance distinctions, image–answer alignment, and the original supervision distribution. Data-Juicer supports normalization, filtering, and auditing Chen et al. [2023] . We remove duplicates to limit redundant training exposure. Task-specific audits repair or exclude incomplete and incorrect data that would otherwise introduce misleading supervision. To extend coverage, we use CuES for data synthesis Mai et al. [2025] .
blocks.zh: 关于这些不同来源的培训要求保留证据和条件,为每个目标提供理由,同时使其监督与共同决策界面保持一致。 转换将每个问题放在(s, u, C, q (s, u, C,q))格式中,保留动作先决条件,关联性区分,图像-解答对接,以及原始监督分布. Data-Juicer支持正常化,过滤,以及审计陈等 [2023]. 我们消除重复,以限制重复培训。 针对具体任务的审计修复或排除不完全和不正确的数据,否则会造成误导性监督。 为扩大覆盖范围,我们使用CuES进行数据合成Mai等 [2025].

blocks.en: The resulting pool shown in Figure 3 contains 663K examples, comprising 311K text and 352K image–text decisions. Appendix C details the data composition. We annotate examples by domain, capability, task function, difficulty, and learning value. These labels group examples into semantic slices whose training dynamics and decision accuracy can be analyzed together. blocks.en: 3 Recursive Self-Improvement with Data-driven Agents
blocks.zh: 3 数据驱动代理的递归自我改进

blocks.en:
In conventional model development, failed training runs are discarded as sunk compute costs. In Piccolo’s RSI process, we capture and organize every successful or regressive experiment as structured epistemic capital.
By binding fine-grained semantic slices, training dynamics, and weight-space trajectories into a persistent research memory, our agent orchestrator transforms brute-force hyperparameter search into cumulative scientific discovery.
blocks.zh:
在传统的模型开发中,失败的训练跑被放弃作为沉入计算成本. 在皮克洛的RSI进程中,我们捕捉并组织每一个成功或倒退的实验作为结构化的认知资本.
通过捆绑精细的语义切片, 训练动力学, 和重量空间轨迹 形成一个持久的研究记忆, 我们的代理管弦乐家 将野蛮力量超参数搜索 转化为累积的科学发现。

blocks.en: Running the atomic loop requires coordinating feedback, data and model assets, execution, and human guidance. We organize these functions into an orchestrator, maintaining ℛ t \mathcal{R}_{t} through versioned records of experiment lineage and proposal priorities across concurrent branches (Figure 4 ).

blocks.en: Semantic labels align training dynamics, inference outcomes, and data statistics by source, supervision, and candidate count. Hard-target cross-entropy tracks the probability assigned to the correct candidate Tewari and Bartlett [2007] , Zhang [2004] ; for soft targets, subtracting target entropy yields target–prediction KL (Appendix B ). Loss trajectories describe how the predicted distribution evolves, while repeated inference tracks repaired and newly missed decisions. Aggregating these signals by semantic slice reveals differences in learning progress among examples with shared domain and capability tags. The agent links these observations to sample records to identify coverage gaps, uneven learning, and label conflicts. These findings guide the data actions in Figure 4 : downsampling redundant examples, rebalancing mixtures, revising conflicting labels, and synthesizing examples for underrepresented capabilities.
blocks.zh: 语义标签将培训动态、推论结果和按来源、监督和候选人计数分列的数据统计统一起来。 硬目标交叉通向跟踪分配给正确候选人Tewari和Bartlett的概率[2007],Zhang [2004]; 对于软目标,去掉目标 en收成目标-预测KL(附录B). 损失轨迹描述预测分布是如何演变的,而重复的推论轨迹则修复并被新错过了决定. 通过语义切片将这些信号相加,揭示出共享域名和能力标记的例子在学习进展上的差异. 代理将这些观测结果与样本记录相链接,以识别覆盖差距,不均匀的学习,并给冲突贴上标签. 这些调查结果指导了图4中的数据行动:对多余的例子进行下取样,对混合物进行再平衡,修订相互矛盾的标签,以及合成代表能力不足的例子。

blocks.en: 4 Performance and Model–Data Co-Evolution
blocks.zh: 4 性能和模型-数据共同演变

blocks.en:
Post-training is traditionally treated as optimizing a dynamic model over a static data recipe.
Piccolo reframes data-model development as a coupled dynamical system: as the model’s capability boundary shifts, the optimal data distribution and recipe must shift with it. A recipe that accelerates learning in an early checkpoint or on one backbone generation can induce regressions in another.
blocks.zh:
培训后的传统做法是优化动态模型而不是静态数据配方。
Piccolo将数据模型开发重新设定为一个组合的动态系统:随着模型的能力边界变化,最佳数据分布和配方必须随之而去。 一种在早期检查站或在某一骨干一代上加速学习的食谱可能会在另一代人中引起后退.

Figure 8 aligns the resulting allocations with each branch’s scores. Rebalancing elevated Public Text to 67.93, versus 67.36 for the fixed recipe. Adding filtering reached 84.58 Harness and 82.20 Data , with Text at 66.98.

blocks.en: Figure 8: Data allocations and outcomes across a fixed recipe, feedback-guided rebalancing, and rebalancing with additional filtering. Blue/tan cells mark allocation increases/decreases from the fixed recipe. Right-hand cells report final scores and signed changes from that reference. Takeaway: Rebalancing gives the strongest Text result; adding filtering improves Harness and Data, producing distinct capability profiles from different data actions.

blocks.en:
Joint decision training combined general decisions, image-dependent tasks, and workflow additions, with replay material for established skills. OCR-aware SFT aligned supervision with image-associated text available at inference. At one consolidation node, a Qwen3.6-27B descendant improved from 71.89 to 79.59 on Vision, 68.64 to 81.36 on Harness, and 73.20 to 81.40 on Data (Figure 9 a).
Crucially, newer backbones do not guarantee across-the-board superiority under a fixed recipe (Figure 9 b).
Trained on the exact same data order, the earlier Qwen3.5 initialization (79.97) outperformed both Qwen3.6 and Qwen3.8 on Vision (79.59 and 77.86), whereas Qwen3.8 dominated agentic Harness tasks (85.93), versus 80.85 and 81.36 for Qwen3.5 and Qwen3.6. Model initialization and data recipes must therefore be co-adapted to match target deployment priorities.
blocks.zh:
联合决策培训结合了一般决定、依图像而定的任务和工作流程的增加,同时为既定技能提供回放材料。 OCR-有意识的 SFT 与图像相关文本对齐,可以推断。 在一个合并节点,一个Qwen3.6-27B后裔从71.89到79.59,从68.64到81.36到Harness,从73.20到81.40到Data(图9a)。
关键是,较新的骨干不能保证固定食谱下的全局优势(图9b).
根据完全相同的数据顺序进行训练,早期的Quen3.5初始化(79.97)在Visual(79.59和77.86)上的表现都超过了Quen3.6和Quen3.8,而Quen3.8主导了代理哈尼斯任务(85.93),而Quen3.5和Quen3.6则分别是80.85和81.36. 因此,模型初始化和数据配方必须共同适应目标部署优先事项。

blocks.en: Figure 9: Recipe–model interaction. (a) Qwen3.6-27B before and after joint training. (b) Three 27B initializations trained with the same recipe and data order. Vision scores use the Public suite. Takeaway: Joint recipes deliver broad gains across tasks (a), while the optimal backbone depends heavily on the target deployment domain (b).
blocks.zh: 图9:道具-模型交互. (a) 联合培训前后的Quen3.6-27B。 (b) 三个27B初始化培训,其配方和数据顺序相同。 视觉分数使用公共套房. 取走:联合配方在任务(a)之间产生广泛成果,而最佳主干主要取决于目标部署领域(b)。

blocks.en: 4.3 Model Evolution
blocks.zh: 4.3 模型演变

blocks.en: Model proposals reused these data assets to compare training strategies (M1), model composition and refinement (M2), and inference (M3), linking each choice to its measured capability response.
blocks.zh: 模型建议重新利用这些数据资产来比较培训战略(M1)、模型组成和完善(M2)和推论(M3),将每一种选择与其测量的能力反应联系起来。

blocks.en: Bidirectional attention benefited from matched training and inference: Text development scores reached 69.01 , versus 68.20 with causal attention and 68.14 when only inference became bidirectional. Staged SFT and RL paired broad supervision with targeted adaptation. Full-parameter and low-rank continuations tested how broadly to update the model. OCR-aware SFT established the input–decision correspondence before candidate-level RL and supervised replay addressed residual errors. Objective and data weighting then evolved together: from a shared parent and the same examples, fixed-weight GRPO reached 77.13 Public Vision, candidate CE 77.31, and confidence/progress-weighted GRPO 77.35 . These results made both the supervision format and the distribution of learning weight part of the training proposal.
blocks.zh: 相应的培训和推论使双向关注受益: 文字发展得分达到69.01分,与68.20分相接并引起因果关注;而68.14分则只有推论成为双向. 分阶段的SFT和RL将广泛的监督与有针对性的适应结合起来。 全参数和低档续作测试 如何广泛更新模型。 OCR-aware SFT在候选级别RL之前建立了输入-决定函证,并由监督的回放处理剩余错误。 然后,目标和数据加权一起演变:从一个共同的父母和同样的例子来看,固定重量的GRPO达到了77.13公共远景,候选CE 77.31,信心/进步加权GRPO 77.35。 这些结果使监督形式和学习分量的分配成为培训建议的一部分。

blocks.en: Cross-modal merging combined branches strengthened by different data recipes. In one exploration, retaining the visual modules of an image–text model and blending its language parameters with a text-oriented branch boosted Public Text from 67.89 to 68.15 while trading off Vision from 77.29 to 75.70 (Table 4 a). The mixture retained part of each branch’s advantage. Candidate-distribution integration explored a complementary route inspired by MOPD Ma et al. [2026] . Reference predictions supplement the original targets on selected examples. Exact matching reached 82.80 Data , versus 82.20 for the original-target continuation, while Harness stayed at 84.92 and Vision remained near 77.07 (Table 4 b). These branches provide distinct task profiles for subsequent composition.
blocks.zh: 通过不同数据配方加强跨模式合并联合分支. 在一次探索中,保留图像文本模型的可视化模块并将其语言参数与面向文本的分支相混合,将公共文本从67.89提高到68.15,同时将视觉从77.29提高到75.70(表4a)。 混合物保留了每个分支的部分优势。 候选人-分配整合探索了由MOPD Ma等所启发的补充路线. [2026] (中文(简体) ). 参考预测是对所选实例的原始目标的补充. 精确匹配达到82.80 Data ,而原目标续作为82.20,而Harness则保持在84.92,而Vision仍然接近77.07(表4b)。 这些分支为以后的组成提供了不同的任务简介。

blocks.en: Table 4: Capability integration through (a) language-weight interpolation with visual modules retained and (b) training with reference candidate distributions. Rows compare each parent with its merged or further-trained descendants across tasks. Text and Vision use Public scores.
blocks.zh: 表4:通过(a) 保留视觉模块的语言加权插图和(b) 提供参考候选人分配的培训,实现能力整合。 将每个父母与其合并或经过进一步培训的后代在任务之间进行比较。 文本与视觉使用公共分数.

blocks.en: Weight-space editing refined candidate combinations through module scaling and low-rank update directions Akiba et al. [2025] . One selected configuration combined (i) approximately 5% stronger visual attention projections in blocks 9–17, (ii) slight attenuation of feed-forward outputs in language layers 8–23, (iii) log-decay offsets in selected late gated-attention blocks, and (iv) rank-8 updates to output projections in layers 30–31. The combined model elevated Public Vision to 70.75 (vs. 70.10 for the retained reference), with a 0.68-point Harness decrease. Earlier, merging five data-specialized descendants boosted Public Text to 63.11, surpassing the strongest individual branch at 62.78.
blocks.zh: 重量空间编辑通过模块缩放和低级更新方向Akiba等[2025]来完善候选组合. 一种选定的配置组合如下:(一) 第9至17个区块中约5%的视觉注意度预测,(二) 第8至23个区块中向导产出略有减少,(三) 某些后入门-注意区块中的日志减值抵消,(四) 第30至31个区块中产出预测的排名-8更新。 综合模型将"公共视野"提升到70.75(保留参考文献为70.10),其中哈能分下降0.68分. 早些时候,合并了五个数据专业的后人将"公开文本"提升到63.11,以62.78的成绩超过了最强的个人分支.

Two half-step passes over each of two adjacent ranges raised Text development scores from 69.15 to 69.75 and Harness from 80.85 to 87.12 . Reusing a single range yielded 69.58 on Text, whereas reducing the two-range step to one quarter lowered the score to 67.41. blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: 5.1 Optimizing Single Benchmarks Masks Cross-Task Regressions
blocks.zh: 5.1 优化单一基准

blocks.en:
Isolated gains in one capability often mask severe regressions in another, even without weight updates. Merely reorganizing the input layout at fixed weights boosted Public Text by +1.14 points while causing a 3.00-point drop on DataJevBench (Figure 11 a).
Semantic slices locate the affected capabilities; held-out task and source groups assess their transfer (Section 3.2 ). This profile identifies the skills to preserve or strengthen in subsequent data revisions.
blocks.zh:
一种能力的孤立收益往往掩盖另一种能力的严重倒退,即使没有更新重量。 仅仅对固定重量的输入布局进行重组,就将公共文本提升了+1.14分,同时造成DataJev Bench上3.00分的下降(图11a).
语义切片确定受影响能力;搁置任务和来源小组评估其转移(第3.2节)。 该简介确定了在随后的数据修订中保存或加强的技能。

blocks.en: Figure 11: Cross-task responses to (a) input reorganization at fixed weights and (b) repeated training on a fixed pool. Zero marks the starting score; positive and negative values indicate gains and regressions. Takeaway: Gains and regressions coexist across tasks, making cross-task validation central to proposal selection and the choice between further training and revised data.
blocks.zh: 图11:对(a) 固定重量的投入重组和(b) 固定池的再培训的跨任务响应。 0标出起分;正值和负值表示得分和回归. Takeaway:收益和回归在任务之间并存,使跨任务验证成为提案选择和进一步培训和修订数据之间选择的核心.

blocks.en: 5.2 More Compute on Fixed Data Degrades Generalization
blocks.zh: 5.2 对固定数据进行更多计算

blocks.en:
Scaling training exposures on a static data pool skews the capability balance rather than uniformly improving the model. Over 1M sample exposures on a fixed pool, Data scores crept up by + + 0.60, but Text and Harness degraded significantly by − - 1.29 and − - 1.69 points (Figure 11 b).
This demonstrates that dynamic data curation is more compute-efficient than prolonged static training.
In addition, the diverging trajectories motivate comparing longer training with revised coverage and allocation. Proposals from a shared retained model make these alternatives directly comparable.
blocks.zh:
在静态数据库上扩大培训范围会扭曲能力平衡,而不是统一改进模型。 固定池上超过1M个样本暴露,Data得分上升了++ 0.60分,但Text和Harness的分数大幅下降--1.29分和-1.69分(图11b)。
这表明,动态数据校正比长期静态培训更具计算效率。
此外,不同的轨迹促使将较长的培训与订正的覆盖面和分配相比较。 共同保留模式的建议使这些替代办法具有直接可比性。

blocks.en: Inference introduces another allocation choice. Adaptive rereading achieved 68.56 Public Text; three-view aggregation further reached 68.71 with 2.04 × \times the input tokens of adaptive rereading. Structural changes were similarly sensitive to their setting: two-band half-step recurrence gained 0.60 Text development points, whereas quarter-step recurrence lost 1.74 (Figure 10 ). Head- and channel-level rescaling also entered the search; strong visual-branch attenuation failed to improve the retained development score. The useful computation depends on both the task and the current model.
blocks.zh: 推论引入了另一种分配选择。 适应性再读实现 68.56 公用文本; 三取集进一步达到 68.71 有 2.04 ×\时间 适应性再读的输入符. 结构变化对其设置同样敏感:双波段半步重现得到0.60 文本开发点,而季度重现损失为1.74(图10)。 头级和频道级的分级调整也进入了搜索中;强烈的视觉分支衰减未能改善所保留的开发分数. 有用的计算取决于任务和目前的模型.

blocks.en: 5.3 Capability Integration and Research Reuse
blocks.zh: 5.3 能力整合和研究

blocks.en: Combining specialized branches changes which capabilities survive. The cross-modal merge in Table 4 a gained 0.26 Public Text points over its image–text parent while losing 1.59 Vision points. Candidate-distribution matching produced a smaller redistribution: Data improved by 0.60 over training on the original targets, with Harness unchanged and Vision nearly unchanged (Table 4 b). Branch selection can use complementary task strengths, with the retained gains measured after integration.
blocks.zh: 整合专门分支,改变生存能力。 表4中的交叉模式合并了0.26 公共文本在图像-文本母体上标出,而失去1.59 远景点。 候选人分配匹配产生了较小的再分配: 数据比最初目标的培训增加了0.60个,哈尼斯和远景几乎没有变化(表4b)。 分支选择可以使用互补的任务优势,在整合后衡量所保留的收益.

blocks.en:
Even “failed” training runs contain actionable gradient signals. In one notable lineage, a continuation branch regressed below its parent on the development set; however, extracting specific components of its parameter update and applying them with a negative coefficient yielded a winning weight-space merge.
This underscores the value of preserving full experimental lineage: by connecting parent checkpoints, parameter deltas, and slice-level responses, the orchestrator converts apparent dead-ends into composable building blocks for future iterations (Appendix D.5 ).
blocks.zh:
即使“失败”的训练也含有可操作的梯度信号。 在一个显著的世系中,一个续行分支在开发集上倒向母体以下;然而,取出其参数更新的具体组件并用负系数应用这些组件,产生了取胜的权重-空间合并.
这突出了保留完整的实验分界线的价值:通过连接母检查点、参数三角洲和切片级响应,管弦乐团将表面的死角转换成可混合的构件,用于未来的迭代(附录D.5)。

blocks.en: 5.4 Relation to Prior Work
blocks.zh: 5.4 与先前工作的关系

blocks.en: Decision-model research explores complementary training and inference choices. Mammoth and Elephant combine data recipes and bidirectional attention Kirkby et al. [2026] ; Drex studies supervised and reinforcement learning Dhankhar et al. [2026] ; StartLux adds confidence-guided deliberation Zhuang et al. [2026] . Evolutionary merging and MOPD study capability integration Akiba et al. [2025] , Ma et al. [2026] . Agentic Data Engineering Ding et al. [2026] and open-ended self-improvement Zhang et al. [2026] guide research through feedback and accumulated discoveries. Piccolo connects these ideas through candidate-level feedback, evolving data recipes, and reusable model branches.
blocks.zh: 决策模型研究探索辅助培训和推论选择. 哺乳动物和大象结合了数据食谱和双向关注克比等. [2026]; Drex 研究监督并强化学习 Dhankhar 等 [2026]; StartLux 添加了信任指导审议.  Zhu等 [2026]. 进化合并与MOPD研究能力整合 Akiba等 [2025]., Ma等 [2026]. 代理 数据工程 丁等 [2026] 和可自由自修 张等. [2026]通过反馈和累积发现指导研究. Piccolo通过候选级别的反馈,不断发展的数据配方,以及可再使用的模型分支,将这些想法联系起来.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion and Future Directions
blocks.zh: 6 结论和未来方向

blocks.en: Piccolo demonstrates that advancing frontier decision models requires more than scaling parameters or static datasets; it requires scaling the research loop itself. Through Agentic Data Engineering, Piccolo co-evolves data curricula and model weights across a 0.8B to 27B family, establishing state-of-the-art performance across visual judgment, agent harnesses, data workflows, and interactive control.
blocks.zh: Piccolo表明,推进前沿决策模型不仅需要缩放参数或静态数据集;还需要缩放研究循环本身。 通过Agentic Data Engineering,Piccolo共同将数据课程和模型权重跨出一个0.8B到27B家族,建立跨越视觉判断,代理牵引,数据工作流程,以及交互控制的最先进的性能.

blocks.en: Beyond the released weights, our development campaign exposes fundamental dynamics of post-training: surrogate loss optimization frequently decouples from discrete decision accuracy, static data pools inevitably induce cross-capability interference, and optimal data recipes are strictly contingent on backbone initialization. By embedding these diagnostics into an autonomous, memory-backed orchestration loop, we shift post-training from manual trial-and-error to systematic, self-correcting engineering.
blocks.zh: 除了释放的权重外,我们的发展运动还暴露出培训后的基本动态:替代损失优化经常与独立决定的准确性脱钩,静态数据集合不可避免地会引发跨能力干扰,最佳数据配方严格取决于骨干初始化. 通过将这些诊断嵌入到一个自主的,内存后支撑的管弦循环中,我们把后期训练从人工试验和过敏转向系统化,自我校正的工程.

blocks.en: Looking forward, the convergence of fast System-1 decision models and deliberative System-2 reasoning points toward hybrid cognitive architectures. Future work will extend this recursive co-evolution to adaptive test-time deliberation, multi-turn environmental interaction, and automated synthesis for long-tail capability frontiers; ultimately advancing not just the models that make decisions, but the autonomous systems that build them.
blocks.zh: 展望未来,快速System-1决策模型和审议System-2推理的趋同点向了混合认知架构. 今后的工作将把这种递归式的共同演进扩大到适应性测试-时间审议、多回合环境互动、以及长尾能力前沿的自动化合成;最终不仅推动决策模式,而且推动建立这些模式的自主系统。

blocks.en: B.1 Supervision and Decision Error
